imageUpdate.description: Scan one current and one proposed Docker image to prove what an image update actually removes.
imageUpdate.title: Verified image-update security comparison
imageUpdate.fixableMeaning: Here, package-fix findings are CVEs for which Scout knows a patched package version. Only this candidate scan proves whether the proposed application image contains those fixes.
imageUpdate.counts: Package-fix findings: current {current_critical} critical, {current_high} high | candidate {candidate_critical} critical, {candidate_high} high
imageUpdate.verdict.verified-clean: [VERIFIED] This image update removes all {removed} current critical/high package-fix findings; 0 remain.
imageUpdate.verdict.verified-improvement: [VERIFIED REDUCTION] This image update removes {removed} current critical/high finding(s), but {remaining} remain.
imageUpdate.verdict.mixed-improvement: [MIXED REDUCTION] The candidate has {remaining} critical/high findings, a net reduction of {removed}, but it introduces {new} new finding ID(s). Review them; this is not eligible for automatic remediation.
imageUpdate.verdict.already-clean: [OK] The current and candidate artifacts have no critical/high package-fix findings under this policy.
imageUpdate.verdict.not-improved: [NOT IMPROVED] The candidate removes no net critical/high findings; {remaining} remain.
imageUpdate.verdict.regression: [REJECTED] The candidate is not a safe security improvement: {remaining} critical/high finding(s) remain and {new} new finding ID(s) were detected.
imageUpdate.compatibility: Compatibility is NOT verified: {detail} Security evidence alone never authorizes deployment.
imageUpdate.compatibility.repository-cha: the image repository/product changed, so migration requirements and release notes must be tested.
imageUpdate.compatibility.same-major: both images expose the same visible major version, but runtime behavior still requires testing.
imageUpdate.compatibility.major-change: the visible major version changed, so treat this as a potentially breaking upgrade.
imageUpdate.compatibility.unknown: the image metadata does not prove a comparable release version.
imageUpdate.ownImages: Images you build are supported: update the Dockerfile base image and OS/language dependencies, rebuild under a new local tag, then pass that tag as --candidate-image.

imageUpdate.error.service-unresolved: [ERROR] The live Swarm service could not be resolved exactly: {detail}

remediation.description: Guide or safely execute evidence-backed remediation of Swarm image vulnerabilities.
remediation.serviceOption: {service} - {critical} critical, {high} high; image shared by {shared} service(s)
remediation.nextPrompt: Press Enter for the next image, or q to stop:
remediation.detailRisk: Priority: {critical} critical, {high} high; this image is used by {shared} service(s).
remediation.detailTerminal: 0) Open a second terminal now (unless it is already open) and keep this guide visible in the first terminal.
remediation.terminalPrompt: Press Enter when the second terminal is ready, or q to cancel:
remediation.detailInspect: 1) Analyze the current image and identify a safe replacement:
remediation.currentEvidenceReused: The current critical/high CVE evidence comes from the fresh swarm-info report; the candidate is scanned separately before it is proposed.
remediation.analysisStarting: Running read-only Scout, image-version, and candidate checks now. This can take several minutes...
remediation.currentVersionUnknown: Detected current release: unknown. A digest proves content identity, but it cannot reveal a historical application version unless the image publisher included version metadata.
remediation.scoutBaseAdvice: Scout rebuild advice: current base image {base}; same-tag refresh {refresh}. This is a base-image change for the image publisher, not automatically a deployable application tag.
remediation.scoutNoBase: Scout did not identify a base image for this artifact.
remediation.scoutAdviceFailed: Scout recommendations could not be collected: {detail}
remediation.scoutAdviceUnavailable: Scout returned no structured base-image recommendation. Run the displayed command to inspect its complete report.
remediation.proposalValidated: Validated replacement: {candidate} (source: {source}; candidate findings: {critical} critical, {high} high).
remediation.proposalReduction: Verified image-update effect: {removed} critical/high finding(s) removed; {remaining} remain in the candidate.
remediation.proposalSource.latest-refres: new digest currently published under latest
remediation.compatibility.major-change: visible major-version change - review release notes and backups before deployment
remediation.compatibility.unknown: unknown - image metadata does not prove both release versions
remediation.latestRefreshAction: The upstream tag remains latest. If the deployment source already uses mutable latest, no tag edit is needed: redeploy with image resolution enabled so Docker resolves the new digest.
remediation.policyCoverage: The local remediation policy authorizes this candidate for {count} affected service(s). Other consumers still require their own reviewed policy entry for automatic execution.
remediation.proposalRejected: Candidate rejected: {candidate}. Reason: {reason}. It will not be placed in an update command.
remediation.proposalReason.current-count: the current finding counts are invalid
remediation.proposalReason.current-findi: the current report lacks finding IDs required for a safe comparison
remediation.proposalReason.candidate-new: the candidate introduces new critical/high findings
remediation.proposalReason.candidate-not: the candidate does not reduce critical/high risk
remediation.proposalReason.unknown: the candidate did not pass the safety validator
remediation.proposalState.policy-conflic: No proposal was selected because affected services have conflicting policy candidates. Reconcile the installation policy first.
remediation.proposalState.latest-unresol: The image uses latest, but this Docker installation could not resolve the current registry digest safely. Do not guess a version; inspect upstream releases manually.
remediation.proposalState.latest-current: The registry's current latest digest matches the deployed digest. Redeploying the same tag will not remove these findings; choose a maintained newer release or wait for the publisher.
remediation.proposalState.manual-review: No safe deployable application-image replacement was proven automatically. Review upstream releases or add a digest-pinned candidate to the installation remediation policy.
remediation.detailMeaning: --only-fixed means a package fix exists; it does not guarantee that the publisher has released a ready replacement application-image tag.
remediation.detailFirstParty: If you build this image: apply the shown base/dependency updates in source, rebuild, push an immutable candidate, and scan it.
remediation.detailThirdParty: If an upstream project builds it: choose a maintained release from that publisher. Never substitute Scout's base-image tag as the application-image tag.
remediation.detailVex: If a finding is genuinely not exploitable, document a reviewed VEX exception instead of silently ignoring it.
remediation.detailCompareCandidate: Prove a concrete replacement (including a maintained replacement repository) before editing or deploying:
remediation.detailCandidateSource: Replace its image reference with the validated candidate: {candidate}
remediation.detailLatestRedeploy: The source already follows latest. Keep it unchanged and redeploy to resolve the validated digest {candidate}.
remediation.detailSourceUnverified: The deployment path is identified, but its source is stale or could not be rendered with the active .env. Reconcile it manually; automatic source editing is disabled.
remediation.detailEditReview: Review the declarative change before deployment:
remediation.detailDeploy: 3) Deploy the owning stack after any required backup:
remediation.detailQuickStart: 3) Use the owning repository's quick-start menu to render, review, and deploy the stack:
remediation.detailUnknown: 2) Deployment source is unresolved ({reason}). Do not guess a file; rerun and review the mapper:
remediation.detailUnknownService: 2) {service} - deployment source is unresolved ({reason}). Do not guess a file; rerun and review the mapper:
remediation.locationPrompt: Open the shown deployment directory in another terminal, then press Enter to continue (q cancels):
remediation.detailRuntimeWarning: A direct service update is temporary configuration drift. Prefer fixing declarative source; use this only as a guarded emergency action:
remediation.detailFocusedVerify: First verify only this service's currently deployed image:
remediation.detailFullVerify: Then confirm Swarm-wide remediation when ready:
remediation.reportNotActionable: The current vulnerability report cannot be remediated in this mode (state: {state}). Run a fresh complete scan first.
remediation.policyMissing: No installation policy exists yet; the built-in safe assessment will create an inert review queue.
remediation.reviewStarting: Assessing built-in safe actions and policy gaps. Fixed tags are recorded without guessing replacements; only moved latest tags need candidate scans.
remediation.reviewCreated: Created installation-owned remediation policy and review queue at {path} ({entries} entries).
remediation.reviewUpdated: Updated the generated review queue in {path} ({entries} entries); operator-owned targets were preserved.
remediation.reviewSummary: Built-in safe latest refreshes ready: {safe} | Blocked items requiring review: {blocked}
remediation.reviewInert: The generated_review section is evidence only. It cannot authorize source edits, runtime overrides, backup exemptions, or unattended deployment.
remediation.reviewEdit: To override a blocked default, review {path}, copy its suggested_target into targets, replace missing values, document backup handling, then explicitly enable it.
remediation.reviewGuidanceGenerated: generated_review is machine-owned evidence refreshed on the next auto-remediation assessment; the latest sanitized attempt is retained, but this section is never authorization.
remediation.reviewGuidanceTargets: Only entries deliberately copied into targets and enabled by an operator can grant persisted remediation authority.
remediation.reviewGuidanceCandidate: candidate_image must name the same repository, include a tag, and be pinned to a complete sha256 digest; null means no safe candidate was discovered.
remediation.reviewGuidanceBackup: Change backup.status to not_required only after documenting why deployment cannot damage persistent data, or complete the required backup first.
remediation.reviewGuidanceSource: Review mapping evidence and configure an exact source adapter before authorizing source edits; unresolved paths remain runtime overrides.
remediation.reviewGuidanceForce: force-auto-remedy-attempt can bypass only auto_eligible=false; it never bypasses backup, digest, repository, validation, confirmation, convergence, or rollback guards.
remediation.refreshingMap: Revalidating the reviewed deployment map against the live Swarm before planning mutations...
remediation.planSummary: Eligible policy targets: {eligible} | Blocked: {blocked} | Declarative edits: {declarative} | Latest refreshes: {latest} | Runtime overrides: {runtime}
remediation.planSafeReady: built-in safe action; two confirmations required
remediation.reason.service-not-vulnerabl: service is not vulnerable in the current report
remediation.reason.repository-mismatch: current image repository differs from policy
remediation.reason.current-image-mutable: current image has no immutable rollback digest
remediation.reason.backup-not-exempt: backup is required or not classified
remediation.planSaved: The atomic review plan was written to {path}.
remediation.validating: Scanning the immutable candidate for {service} before changing anything...
remediation.candidateAccepted: Candidate accepted: {removed} critical/high finding(s) removed, {remaining} remain ({critical} critical, {high} high), and no new finding ID was introduced.
remediation.safeLatestReady: Built-in safe refresh for {service}: visible version {current} -> {candidate}; validated image {image}.
remediation.safeLatestSource: Verified source in {directory} already follows latest. This one-service refresh does not edit that source or refresh unrelated stack images.

remediation.safeLatestUpdateConfirm: Update service {service} in Docker context {context} to the validated same-major latest digest? [y/N]:

remediation.runtimeConfirm: Temporarily update service {service} in Docker context {context}? [y/N]:
remediation.reviewDiff: Review the exact declarative source diff:
remediation.applyConfirm: Apply the reviewed change atomically to {path}? [y/N]:
